st: The Journey Within - "Hunting Anatolian Chamois in Turkey With Mark Peterson
d: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

st: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2
d: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

st: The Raven Project - "Summer Prep And Randy Raven Bow Kill
d: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.
Evan Williams from Hoyt and Tyler Jordan hit the mountains of Colorado in search of rutting Mule Deer with their bows, but the hunt takes an unexpected turn.
National Guard veteran Justin Klemm recalls his time in service leading troops while dealing with his secret life of addiction.
JP heads to upstate New York to take a shot at ice fishing for Walleye.
The second day in Steinhatchee, Capt. Blair & Jay finally find where all the reds got off too, and I mean ALL the reds. This is one of the craziest sights on the show yet.
Today, Capt. Danny is joining his good friend, Crystal River local, and big fish master  Capt. Socrates Conomos. The two are in search of whatever swims, as long as it's big…
Low Tide, a Fort and the potential for a Historic Coast Slam, Capt. Jonathan Moss is fishing in St. Augustine, Florida, with Capt. Mike Keith.

In this episode Capt. Jason and Capt. Buck Fish for sea trout to cook up for Lunch at The Wharf. After lunch, they head to the beach for an afternoon outgoing tide in search of Snook.

st: The Green Way Outdoors - "Great Lakes Extreme Fishing
d: Kyle explores the Great Lakes on his Sea-Doo in search of walleye and lake trout.

In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch' stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland
